vocabulary.definition: too large, extensive, or extreme to measure
vocabulary.example: The potential benefits of colonizing the Moon are immeasurable.

vocabulary.definition: make full use of and derive benefit from (a resource)
vocabulary.example: Colonizing the Moon would allow us to exploit its unlimited resources.

vocabulary.definition: able to produce enough for one's own needs without external assistance
vocabulary.example: The Moon base aims to become self-sufficient by exporting resources to Earth.

vocabulary.definition: the layer of unconsolidated rocky material covering bedrock
vocabulary.example: Robotic mining rigs sift through lunar regolith to extract valuable resources.

vocabulary.definition: of or from outside the Earth or its atmosphere
vocabulary.example: The first extraterrestrial child born on the Moon will be a historic event.

vocabulary.definition: make or become united, uniform, or whole
vocabulary.example: Colonizing the Moon could unify nations in a common goal for the future of humanity.
